_comments.security_warning: The DevConnection uses hardcoded credentials for local development only.
_comments.production_setup: For production, use environment variables or secure secret storage.
environment_variables: DB_USER - Database username (create dedicated app user, not postgres)
secure_alternatives: Azure Key Vault - for Azure deployments
AWS Secrets Manager - for AWS deployments
HashiCorp Vault - for enterprise secret management
Docker Secrets - for Docker Swarm deployments
_comments.connection_string_builder: Consider using NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder in code for dynamic configuration
